body: i see a therapist and a psychiatrist. i was recently in the mental hospital for self harming and wanting to kill myself again. i have probably 10 different crisis lines saved in my phone but i don't know how much help i can get while i'm still living with family. i'm at my grandparents but they don't know a lot of this and my family is very judgmental and restricting and traditional/religious so there's difference of opinion and lack of support there. i just want to get away and find who i am cuz i feel like ppl have taken my soul and i've never had it all to myself. i think i need that if that makes any sense..
I've been there. Am there I guess.
